purpose: Define the exact promotion contract from measured Mandala fields to stable Atomic-Kode identities without assuming field count, raster resolution, H-441, H-22, or symbolic meaning.

inputs.outerDomain: supported MF:Rxx:Sxx records from MF-288 continuity census
inputs.centralDomain: supported CR-MF:Lx:Cxx records from independent central-rose census
inputs.bridgeRelations: observed/measured relations between outer and central domains from unified-field-topology-contract.v0.1

allRequired: field boundary is reproducibly identifiable in a locked source
field has measured geometry or compositional identity sufficient to distinguish it from neighbors
field provenance points to locked source evidence
field is not an artifact produced only by text, ornament, compression, or arbitrary rasterization
field survives the relevant cross-source or source-specific classification rule
authority of every asserted property is explicit

akIdentity.assignmentOrder: deterministic traversal defined only after supported topology is frozen
akIdentity.immutabilityRule: Once a field is promoted to a canonical AK and referenced by canonical HNK artifacts, its AK ID must not be silently reassigned. Corrections require explicit supersession/migration records.

postPromotionLayers.rule: Correspondence and projection layers attach to AK/topology after structural identity; they do not create AK identity.

glyphGenesisContract.requiredTraceability: Every generated glyph manifestation must trace back to AK IDs and transformation/projection versions.

g4OpenCondition: Both outer and central censuses have explicit evidence statuses, supported fields have a frozen topology candidate, and unresolved regions are represented as unresolved rather than target-fitted.
g4PassCondition: Every promoted AK satisfies the promotion predicate, IDs are assigned deterministically, topology validates without dangling references, and no AK depends on an arbitrary render grid.
